reason.why: The core value of a real-time video codec is the computation: compressing and decompressing video frames in real time. It is not stateful records with actions performed on them through an API, so a record-based world would not replicate it. What would make it feasible: A request about stateful records, such as a video transcoding job queue where an agent submits, prioritizes, retries and cancels jobs, or a media asset library with renditions and publishing states.
